title: Binance hack: developing story
summary: The largest crypto theft on record: attackers drained Binance hot wallets on ten blockchains on Oct 29; part of the money has been frozen and Binance has paused withdrawals on several networks.

facts.label: Stolen
facts.note: Binance's own estimate of the impact (Reuters); TRM Labs US$6.36B at the time taken; Chainalysis at least US$5.9B

facts.label: Frozen so far
facts.note: mostly stablecoins frozen by Tether, Circle and others; Binance says about US$3B

facts.label: Still with the attacker
facts.note: beyond the reach of issuers, per TRM Labs (as of 00:30 UTC Oct 30)

facts.label: When
facts.note: most of it within about 20 minutes

facts.label: Who
facts.note: not confirmed by Binance or any government yet

facts.label: Binance
facts.value: confirmed a security incident; withdrawals paused on several networks
